name: Akatsukinomiya Eris
source:
Owning the Magical Heart "Moonstone"
She possesses an overwhelming power that surpasses other Magical Hearts.

She is the daughter of the chairman of the academy city "Seika Renaissance Polis Fukkou" and serves as the "Student Council President." Pure and beautiful, she always wears a loving smile and is adored and revered by everyone at the academy, akin to a saint. To Towa, however, she is the daughter of her nemesis and a sworn enemy who has inherited all of her power and ambition.

Since childhood, she has been in a romantic relationship with her maid, Yuzuki Celestina, whom she adores like an older sister.
